# generated_hypothesis

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Generates a testable backlog hypothesis from an admitted capability gap.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hypothesis_id` | `string` | yes | Stable generated hypothesis identity. |
| `source_gap_id` | `string` | yes | Capability gap that generated the hypothesis. |
| `candidate_capability` | `string` | yes | Proposed independent capability. |
| `expected_value` | `float` | yes | Bounded expected objective value. |
| `falsifier_contract` | `string` | yes | Executable condition that can disprove the hypothesis. |
